name: Bed, boxspring 160 × 200, without headboard

clearance.note: Room to get in and make the bed

notes: Generic boxspring bed, not a specific product, without a headboard: exactly 160 × 200 cm, so it can stand against the headboard box in the wardrobe's bed alcove (headboard-box-alcove-177), against the alcove's back panel or against a wall. An upholstered box spring on six low feet, a pocket-spring mattress and a topper: feet 7 cm, box spring 28 cm, mattress 21 cm, topper 6 cm, 62 cm in all, in the middle of the usual 50–70 cm (XXXLutz BOXXX 160 × 200: 73 cm as a "comfort height"). The mattress is a surface for cushions and pillows. In the alcove (177 cm wide), it has 8.5 cm to spare on each side, and its side clearance reaches the cheeks.
